title: Fire Safety Blackouts
description: Explains why fire risk rises during outages and covers candle safety and alternatives, safe and unsafe heating, cooking, and generator use. Includes keeping smoke detectors working, the PASS extinguisher technique, when to fight a fire, escape planning, and a prevention checklist.
shortDescription: Candle, heater, cooking, and generator safety when the power is out
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
